name: Accordion
purpose: A single collapsible disclosure — a header that expands/collapses a panel of content, with no JS height measurement needed.
neverUseFor: A single always-visible section — just render the content directly
Primary page navigation — use SideNav/NavItem instead
Hiding required/critical content the user must always see
rationale: Accordion is built on native <details>/<summary> (ADR-001) so toggling, keyboard activation and the expanded state are announced by the browser with no hand-rolled ARIA. The panel animates through a CSS grid row transition instead of JS height measurement, and the open/close timing is fixed by ADR-016 so every disclosure in the system feels the same.

mayExtendLocally: Compose any Helix content (forms, lists, Tables) inside the panel
Stack several Accordions to build an FAQ or settings list
Control the open state from product logic via the documented props
mustEscalateToDS: Replacing <details>/<summary> with a div + button disclosure
Changing the open/close animation timing or easing (ADR-016)
Adding exclusive 'only one open' group behavior or new visual variants

authored.name: expanded
authored.description: Whether the panel is expanded. Uncontrolled via `defaultExpanded`, or controlled via `expanded`/`onExpandedChange` — mirrors Switch's controlled/uncontrolled pattern. The native toggle is intercepted (see useDisclosureTransition) so collapsing can animate before `open` is actually removed — an explicit aria-expanded on the header reflects the target state during that transition.
authored.aria: aria-expanded on the header, explicit (not left to the browser's own <details> mapping) since `open` and the visually-settled state briefly diverge during a collapse

anatomy.description: Native disclosure element — provides the open/closed state, keyboard support, and implicit ARIA for free (see ADR-001: wraps a native element directly, no hand-rolled ARIA pattern needed).
The clickable header. Native focus/keyboard (Enter/Space) support.

Wraps a Tabler chevron-down icon (via the Icon component) — flips vertically (scaleY) between closed (v) and open (^). This is the canonical Helix expand/collapse chevron treatment — see .ai/maps/patterns/expand-collapse-chevron.md before adding a chevron to any other hand-rolled disclosure component.
JS-measured explicit pixel height on open/close, not grid-template-rows 0fr/1fr — 'fr' unit interpolation didn't track the same visual pace in both directions, which read as a laggy collapse.
Clips overflow during the grid-row animation and cross-fades/blurs its content in.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave unset for uncontrolled (see `defaultExpanded`).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires whenever the disclosure toggles, controlled or not.

width.note: Fills its container width, matching Card.

height.note: Header height is content-driven; panel height animates via CSS grid, no fixed rung.

a11y.role: native <details>/<summary> disclosure — no hand-rolled role needed
keyboardNav: Enter / Space on the header — toggles (native <summary> behavior)

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Shows the panel; the chevron flips (scaleY(-1) in code).

properties.name: state
properties.description: focus = the header's focus ring (global :focus-visible); disabled = the `disabled` prop — fill/disabled, border/neutral/light, text/disabled, icon/disabled on the header (the open panel's content keeps its color, like code). No hover style exists in code.

figma.structure: Bordered box (radius/l, border in the layout) > accordion-header (12/16 padding, Body / m / Medium, 16px ChevronDown) + accordion-panel-inner (0/16/12, Body / m / Regular).
